result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The carousel clipping and the partially visible bottom card are expected and not reported. The remaining issues are misaligned cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel and a few minor styling and accessibility concerns.

issues.description: The cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are misaligned vertically. The Green Bowl Poké image is taller and starts higher (~y=631 to 776) than the Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria images (~y=658 to 803). As a result, the titles and delivery-fee lines sit at different baselines (801 vs 829).
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards the same image height and top alignment so the images, titles and delivery text line up across cards.

issues.description: The first carousel card's image has a light gray, washed-out background with rounded corners that differ visually from the dark photos on the other cards. The white time badge also blends into the pale image, which makes the card look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image treatment, such as a uniform crop, overlay or badge shadow, so the badges stay legible and the cards look alike.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, 'Ramen' and the review count) and the inactive tab labels have fairly low contrast against the white background. The heart icon on the second card sits on a semi-transparent dark circle, while the first card's heart has no background, so the two look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive tab colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1), and make the favorite button style consistent across cards.
